reason: .121 reduces foreground interference through background save-worker scheduling, bounded GPU completion-poll backoff, and visible-only diagnostic updates. Automatic additional qualification remains disabled. Native pixels, quality settings, certified output admission and CPU fallbacks remain. Bundle .327 replaces only ULike in active .326. Physical Android responsiveness is unmeasured.
future_ulike_base: Use .121 source and exact standalone hash, but choose the then-current combined baseline from patches-bundle.json. Preserve disabled automatic qualification, exact/fast admission, CPU fallback, all fourteen native assets, capture/save contracts and all other applications. Do not infer device performance from host tests.
q4_scope: Saved-bitmap detected eye geometry with conservative face zones; precise lip contours and semantic hair segmentation are not implemented.
q11_scope: Exact YUV plane layout/sample preservation; no guessed RGB matrix/range or new bit-depth claim.
q13_scope: Direct pixel permutation for eligible quarter-turn/integer-crop cases; keep existing one-pass resampling and native beauty mesh.
current_fix_scope: Set dedicated save/compute owner CPU threads to background priority while preserving the four-worker cap.
Disable photo ADPF performance hints without changing pixel calculations.
Back off GPU completion polling from 0.25 ms to 2 ms while preserving ownership, cancellation and timeout behavior.
Request guarded HD texture-render release after matching the current activity, camera, capture epoch and source bitmap; preserve save/shutter ownership.
Skip hidden diagnostic views, coalesce each visible view to one queued refresh, and report API/request observations without claiming measured frame recovery.
front_completion_scope: A committed native-handler preview stop/resume may complete after the admission deadline; no extra stop is admitted.
diagnostic_measurement_scope: Single-image noise/additional correction/compression/save intervals; fusion remains disabled. Encoder start-to-stop excludes construction/prewarm, and native standard beauty and capture wait are outside stage measurements. Overall elapsed starts at trace admission, not necessarily at the shutter button.
gpu_policy: Keep two independent complete-output comparisons and saved exact failures. Forecasts require two distinct captures within the existing 12-second lifetime and conservatively include current stage/bank costs. Cold Strong foreground uses CPU and bounded fresh idle snapshots. Finish qualification uses actual CPU timing and also the legacy GPU reference whenever usable; candidates must win by five percent. Certified routes still need a transfer-inclusive completion-time win. Existing memory, bank-wait, cancellation and family-fairness limits remain required.
